description_en: Modifies an instance. Currently, only the PostgreSQL engine is supported
description_zh: 修改实例，目前仅支持PostgreSQL引擎
name: ModifyDBInstance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true (default): Automatically uses coupons.
false: Does not automatically use coupons.

After a coupon is used, the amount deducted by the coupon is not refunded if you downgrade the instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：是。
false：否。

使用优惠券后，若需要进行降配操作，由代金券抵扣的金额将不会进行退款
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
The effective period for the new configurations. Valid values:
Changing some configurations may affect the instance. Read the impact section in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96061.html before you configure this parameter. Perform the operation during off-peak hours.
Immediate (default): The new configurations take effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The new configurations take effect during the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610402.html.
ScheduleTime: The new configurations take effect at a specified time. The time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time. The actual switchover time follows the formula: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime. Allocate sufficient time for the switchover
parameters.help_zh:
新配置生效时间，取值：
变更部分配置可能对实例产生影响，请仔细阅读https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96061.html，再配置该参数，建议在业务低峰期进行。
Immediate（默认值）：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610402.html生效。
ScheduleTime：指定时间切换。该时间需为当前时间12小时之后的一个时刻，且实际切换时间遵循EffectiveTime=ScheduleTime+SwitchTime
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en: The time at which the parameter modification is executed. The EffectiveTime parameter must be set to ScheduleTime. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC). The time must be later than the current time (the time when the call is made)
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改参数的执行时间。需要EffectiveTime取值ScheduleTime。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 该时间必须大于当前时间（执行调用的时间）
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628785.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html, in GB. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610393.html operation to query the available storage capacity range for the target instance type.

You must specify at least one of this parameter and the DBInstanceClass parameter.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610394.html operation to query the current storage capacity of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html，单位GB，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610393.html接口查询目标实例规格中可用的存储空间范围。

本参数和DBInstanceClass参数两者至少传入一项。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610394.html可以查看实例当前的存储空间大小
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The instance storage type. Valid values:

general_essd: premium performance disk (recommended)
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：

general_essd：高性能云盘（推荐）
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of specification change for the instance. Valid values:

Up (default): Upgrades a subscription instance, or upgrades/downgrades a pay-as-you-go instance.
Down: Downgrades a subscription instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例变配类型，取值：

Up（默认值）：包年包月实例的升级和按量付费实例的升级/降级。
Down：包年包月实例的降级
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: Basic Edition
HighAvailability: High-availability Edition
cluster: Cluster Edition
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列，取值：

Basic：基础系列
HighAvailability：高可用系列
cluster：集群系列
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126002.html of the PostgreSQL instance. If the specification change fails because the current minor engine version is not supported, specify the minor engine version to upgrade the minor engine version during the specification change.

Format: `rds_postgres_<MajorVersion>00_<MinorVersion>`. Example for version 12 with minor version 20200830: `rds_postgres_1200_20200830`
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL实例https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126002.html。当变更实例规格并且报错内核小版本不支持时，需要传入内核小版本号，**用于在变更实例规格时升级内核小版本**。

格式：`rds_postgres_<大版本号>00_<小版本号>`。例如12版本的20200830：`rds_postgres_1200_20200830`
parameters.name: target_minor_version

fields.help_en:
The unique identifier of the node, used to specify a node.
This parameter is valid only for Cluster Edition instances
fields.help_zh:
节点的唯一标识，用于指定节点。
仅对集群版实例有效
fields.name: node_id

fields.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
Master: primary node.
Slave: secondary node.

For Cluster Edition instances, you can leave this parameter empty and specify the NodeId parameter to identify the node
fields.help_zh:
节点类型。返回值：
Master：主节点。
Slave：备节点。

集群版实例可不填入，通过填入NodeId参数确定节点
fields.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The parameters and their values. All parameter values are of the STRING type. You can call the DescribeParameterTemplates operation to query parameter names and values.

If you specify the ParameterGroupId parameter and both ParameterGroupId and Parameters modify the same parameter, the value specified in Parameters takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
参数及其值，参数的值都是字符串类型。可调用DescribeParameterTemplates查询参数名称和参数值。

传入参数ParameterGroupId，如果ParameterGroupId参数与Parameters参数共同修改了某个参数，则优先使用Parameters参数的改动
parameters.name: parameters

DBInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID. You can call [DescribeDBInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628785.html） to query the instance ID
